title: Flame Splitting Tsunami
summary: Zi Yan, Liu Qing and the other students hold Fan Lao off with their best skills, and Zi Yan is hurt by his Blood Demon Palm. Xiao Yan comes back fighting at Dou Huang strength, borrowed from Yao Lao, and sends his friends back with healing medicine. Watching him, Han Feng recognises the Green Lotus Core Flame, 19th on the Heavenly Flames Ranking, and decides he wants both flames. Fan Lao, chief of the Blood Sect, answers with his Blood Transforming Skill and then the Di Class Great Blood Bodhisattva Devourer, which Xiao Yan meets with his own Flame Splitting Tsunami. Xiao Yan wins the exchange and presses him with Octane Blast, but Fan Lao escapes by cutting himself with a blood technique. Then the Fallen Heart Flame starts to break its seal again.
events: The students fight Fan Lao's Blood Consuming Armor and Blood Demon Palm; Zi Yan is hurt
Liu Qing uses Sky Splitting Mountain; Green Smoke Sword Blade is used against Fan Lao
Xiao Yan returns at Dou Huang strength and sends his friends back with medicine
Han Feng recognises the Green Lotus Core Flame and wants both flames
Fan Lao uses the Blood Transforming Skill
Flame Splitting Tsunami beats Fan Lao's Great Blood Bodhisattva Devourer
Fan Lao flees by wounding himself; the Fallen Heart Flame moves to break its seal
cultivation: Xiao Yan, a Dou Ling, borrows Yao Lao's power and fights at Dou Huang strength (a temporary jump of two levels); onlookers call him 'a young and strong Dou Huang'. Fan Lao says the borrowed power has a time limit. Zi Yan's strength is called greater than a skilled Dou Wang's.
